units.source_text: 写好后，教刚才摘花的那个随从送去。

en.t: After he had written it, he had the attendant who had just picked the flowers deliver it.

units.source_text: 那人家的女子并未见过源氏公子，

en.t: The women of that household had never seen Lord Genji,

units.source_text: 然而公子容貌秀美，一看侧影便可推想而知，

en.t: but his looks were so beautiful that even a glimpse of his profile was enough to imagine what he must be like,

units.source_text: 所以在扇上写了诗送他。

en.t: so they had written a poem on a fan and sent it to him.

units.source_text: 过了一会不见回音，正觉扫兴之际，

en.t: After a while passed with no reply, just as they were beginning to feel disappointed,

units.source_text: 忽然看见公子特地遣使送诗来，大为兴奋，

en.t: they suddenly saw that the prince had gone out of his way to send a messenger with a poem, and they were greatly excited,

units.source_text: 大家就一起商量如何答诗，踌躇不决。

en.t: so they all discussed together how to answer with a poem, but hesitated and could not decide.

units.source_text: 随从不耐烦起来，空手回转了。

en.t: The attendant grew impatient and returned empty-handed.
